scenario: named/bind-dyndb-ldap fails to start after an LDIF restore drops the DNS service ACIs
notes: journal_named shows the documented LDAP 'Insufficient access' signature under cn=dns, so named-service-down fires with upstream_candidates=['directory-server'] and HIGH confidence and takes PRIMARY_PROBLEM. Because named being down also breaks live resolution of the system records, IPADNSSystemRecordsCheck reports ERROR and dns_lookup shows the records failing, so srv-autodiscovery fires too - but since Slice 1 hardening it is RELATED_SYMPTOM of the stopped named (same-pack causality, engine/correlate.py _IMPLICIT_RULE_UPSTREAMS): with this server's named down its records cannot be resolved at all, so they are a symptom, not an independent problem. v0.1.3 showed it as SECONDARY_INDEPENDENT_PROBLEM (see tests/data/GOLDEN_CHANGES.md).
